scope: Selected RPG.GameCore.SetDynamicValueByProperty payloads with ReadTargetType=ModifierOwnerEntity, Value=MaxHP and an explicit DynamicKey.
selected_model: Resolve exactly one ModifierOwnerEntity, read its immutable SurvivalState.max_hp, then synchronously write that Decimal into the selected DynamicValue scope/key. ordering: The MaxHP value visible at this callback sibling is written before the next sibling. This packet does not determine what changes MaxHP or how a missing ContextScope is chosen beyond the pre-existing DynamicValue selected scope model.

dsh_implementation_contract: Keep direct survival MaxHP reads separate from the general property system. Resolve a single source target, copy its current MaxHP into the DynamicValue store at the existing scope boundary, and reject all non-selected property read shapes.
